set_desc: Merge fields into a SoundAttenuation asset's Attenuation settings (absent keys kept), clamp to ClampMin/ClampMax and save; set_properties neither clamps nor saves. Keys match field names case-insensitively. An empty settings object, a key that names no field (the error lists them), a null value, or a value that is not of the field's kind or does not convert is an error and nothing changes. Plugin sub-objects are not reached. A failed save makes success false.
settings_desc: Object of FSoundAttenuationSettings/FBaseAttenuationSettings fields to merge; absent keys untouched. e.g. bAttenuate, bSpatialize, attenuationShape(Sphere/Capsule/Box/Cone), distanceAlgorithm, falloffDistance, dBAttenuationAtMax(-60..0), attenuationShapeExtents{x,y,z}, bAttenuateWithLPF, lPFFrequencyAtMin/Max, bEnableOcclusion, occlusionVolumeAttenuation, bEnableReverbSend, reverbWetLevelMin/Max. Nested plugin sub-objects (pluginSettings, audioLinkSettingsOverride) are NOT authored here. Keys match the field names case-insensitively; an empty object, a key that names no field, a null value or a value that does not convert is an error and nothing is changed.
get_desc: Read the whole FSoundAttenuationSettings struct (shape, falloff, spatialization, LPF, occlusion, reverb send) of a USoundAttenuation asset as one settings object, with the keys set_sound_attenuation_properties takes, plus asset_class. A convenience over get_properties on its Attenuation property, shaped for that write tool; it reads the asset, not what an audio component applies (get_audio_component_properties). Read-only.
